title: 12th Sitting of Third session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/12/3/2026).
From the Speaker's desk: submission of the proposed state budget for 2027, under Article 96(a) of the Constitution.

summary: The sitting was set to receive the government's proposed state budget for 2027.
